Claimant, Amy McDougall, hereinafter referred to as McDougall) is the spouse of Judgment Debtor Rene Peinado) hereinafter
referred to as Peinado. McDougall's elaim appears to be that she keeps her property separate from Peinado's property as Paragraph 4
of the Claim of Exemption states that the property claimed to be exempt is a "Separate bank account." The facts, however, suggest
McDougal1 and Peinado may be comming1ing funds.

For example) attached hereto and marked Exhibit 11 A 11 is a declaration filed in Monterey County Superior Court case McDougall v
Oakshire Owners' Associatoin, at case number 23CV004125. The exhibits to the declaration are lengthy and not provided here. The
case involves a property localed at 10196 Oakwood Circle in Monterey County. The declaration is titled "DECLARATION OF
RENE PEINADO IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF'S OPPOSITION OT DEFEDANT'S MOTION TO STRIKE COMPLAINT
PURSUANT TO CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE 425. l 6;REQUEST FOR ATTORNEYS FEES." Peinado signed the declaration on
April 22, 2024. On Page 2, Paragraph 2 Peinado states "I am Plaintiff Amy McDougall's husband." In Page 2, Paragraph 5 Peinado
states 11 WE put an offer on the lot. .. 1' On Page 3, Paragraph 6 Peinado states 11 Although my wife and I are developing the property
together, she is the sole owner of record for the lot. The zoning of the surrounding properties was a crucial factor in OUR familis
decision to buy the lot .... 11

Also attached hereto and marked Exhibit "B" is a declaration filed on July 12, 2024 in San Francisco County Superior Court case
Stephen Weissberg v Rene Peinado, at case number CGC-99-304332. The declaration is titled "DECLARATION OF RENE
PEINADO IN SUPPORT OF RENE PEINADO'S OPPOSITION TO PLAINTIFF STEPHEN WEISSBERG'S MOTION FOR
ASSIGNMENT OF RENTS AND APPOINTMENT OF RECEIVER." On Page 2, Paragraph 3 Peinado states "I have resided at
2150-2152 Sutter Street, San Francisco with it being my primary residence for more than 23 years ..... Since it is my residence, the
utilities are in my name and/or my wife1s name ..... and my wife has beautifully furnished the home. 11

Per Exhibit 11 A", McDougall and Peinado are NOT keeping their property separate from one another. Peinado states that 11 WE put an
offer on the lot 11 meaning McDougall and Peinado put an offer on the lot together. Further, Peinado states that 11 my wife AND I are
developing property together. u From the declaration of Peinado, it appears that they arc conuningling funds.

Per Exhibit 11 B 11 , Peinado states that 2150 Sutter St; San Francisco is his property. He also states that the utilities are in his name
and/or in his wife 1s name and that his wife has also furnished the home. The fact the utilities at Peinado's property are in McDougall's
name and McDougall is furnishing the home suggests that they are not keeping their property entirely separate as alleged.

Family Code Section 911 (a) states: "The earnings of a married person during marriage are not liable for a debt incurred by the
person's spouse before marriage. After the earnings of the married person are paid, they remain not liable so long as they are held in a
deposit account in which the person's spouse has no right of withdrawal and are uncommingled with other property in the community
estate, except property insignificant in amount. 11

Under the circumstances, absent proof from McDougall that the funds in the subject bank account are not commingled with Peinado's
funds and/or property, the Claim of Exemption should be denied. McDougall has not provided bank statements showing that the
deposits, withdrawals or payments from the account(s) in question arc uncommingled. Per CCP Section 703.580(b): "At the hearing
under this section, the exemption claimant has the burden of proof. 11

While McDougall also seeks to rely on a Premarital Agreement she entered into with Peinado back in 2007, she has not provided a
copy of the Premarital Agreement. If the Court is going to permit McDougall to rely on the Premarital Agreement, National is at least
entitled to review its terms. While the one page Memorandum Of Understanding that has been provided states that no community
property shall be created during marriage, the facts indicate that McDougall and Peinado are now commingling funds and do not keep
their property separate.
